title: Meshinchi-Lab/2026-04-30_wgs_nanopore_variantcallinganno pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input. One row per sample; each row supplies the haplotagged BAM plus the upstream SV, CNA and SNV VCFs that this pipeline merges and annotates. Columns are consumed in subworkflows/local/utils_nfcore_nanopore_variant_calling_anno/main.nf.

id.errorMessage: Sample id must be provided and cannot contain spaces

bam.errorMessage: Haplotagged BAM must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'. An index is required alongside it at '<bam>.bai'.

severus_sv.errorMessage: Severus somatic SV VCF must be provided and must have extension '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz'

savana_sv.errorMessage: SAVANA SV VCF must have extension '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz'. This column is OPTIONAL: leave the value empty (or omit the column) to run the SAVANA process instead of supplying a pre-computed VCF.

wahkan_cnv.errorMessage: Wakhan CNA VCF must be provided and must have extension '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz'. NB the column name is spelled 'wahkan_cnv' in the pipeline.

clairsto_snv.errorMessage: ClairS-TO SNV VCF must be provided and must have extension '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz'

deepsomatic_snv.errorMessage: DeepSomatic SNV VCF must be provided and must have extension '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz'
